_comment: Table catalog for the generic CDC -> Iceberg engine (kafka_to_iceberg_v2.py).
Adding a table = add an entry under 'tables' + restart the job. No code changes.
topic    Kafka topic Debezium publishes to (prefix.schema.table)
key      primary-key column used by MERGE ... ON
columns  ordered [name, type] pairs, defined ONCE and used to build BOTH
the parse schema AND the Iceberg DDL, so they cannot drift apart
(that mismatch was the old updated_at = NULL bug).
'type' = Spark SQL type. Map DEBEZIUM's JSON output, not Postgres:
int/serial -> INT or BIGINT | text/varchar -> STRING |
timestamp/timestamptz -> STRING (Debezium emits an ISO-8601 string) |
